actors.name: Kettlewell allotment society members
actors.private_context: Each member has their own reasons for or against standing for chair. Some may be interested, others not. No member has yet volunteered.

shared_context: The Kettlewell allotment society's chair is stepping down. Nominations for the new chair close at the annual general meeting in five weeks, on 2026-09-29. The society has a membership who can volunteer to stand for chair.

starting_events.description: The chair's stepping down is announced to the membership, and nominations are opened.

resolution: Resolve YES if, before 2026-09-29T20:00:00+01:00, the persistent event history shows that at least one member has formally volunteered to stand for chair (e.g., by submitting a nomination or publicly declaring candidacy). Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
